name: Reply to Email
description: Sends a reply to an Outlook email message with optional HTML formatting, attachments, CC, and BCC recipients.

comment.description: The body content of the reply email. Can be plain text or HTML based on is_html flag.
comment.title: Comment
examples: Thank you for your email. I'll review and respond shortly.

is_html.description: Whether the comment body should be rendered as HTML (true) or plain text (false). When false, HTML tags in the comment will be displayed as literal text.
is_html.title: Is Html

user_id.description: The user's email address or 'me' to indicate the authenticated user. This specifies the mailbox from which the reply will be sent.
user_id.title: User Id

cc_emails.description: List of email addresses for CC recipients.
cc_emails.title: Cc Emails

attachment.description: File(s) to attach to the reply. Accepts a single file or a list of files.

name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service
name.title: Name

s3key.description: The S3 key of a publicly accessible file, typically returned from a previous download action that stored the file in S3. This key references an existing file that can be uploaded to another service.
s3key.title: S3Key

mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file
mimetype.title: Mimetype

name.description: The filename that will be used when uploading the file to the destination service
name.title: Name

s3key.title: S3Key

mimetype.description: The MIME type of the file
mimetype.title: Mimetype

attachment.title: Attachment

bcc_emails.description: List of email addresses for BCC recipients.
bcc_emails.title: Bcc Emails

message_id.description: The Microsoft Graph message ID (NOT an email address). This is a Base64-encoded string typically starting with 'AAMk' (e.g., 'AAMkAGI2TAAA='). Do NOT pass email addresses like 'user@example.com'. Obtain this ID from the 'id' field returned by `OUTLOOK_LIST_MESSAGES`, `OUTLOOK_GET_MESSAGE`, or `OUTLOOK_SEARCH_MESSAGES` actions.
message_id.title: Message Id

error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action
error.title: Error

successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
successful.title: Successful
